verses.text: For the music director. A song. A psalm. Shout for joy to God, all the earth!
Sing about the glory of his name. Give him glory and praise!
Say to God, “Your deeds fill us with awe! Your power is so great that your enemies submit to you.
The whole earth will worship you and sing to you. They’ll sing praise to your name.” Selah.
Come and see what God has done, the wonders he’s worked for humanity.
He turned the sea into dry ground, and his people crossed the river on foot. There we rejoiced in him.
He rules by his power forever. He keeps watch over the nations. Let those who rebel against him keep from rising up. Selah.
Praise our God, you peoples! Let everyone hear you praise him.
He keeps us alive and keeps our feet from slipping.
You’ve tested us, God. You’ve refined us like silver.
You brought us into prison and laid heavy loads on our backs.
You let people ride over our heads. We passed through fire and water, but you brought us out to a place of plenty.
I’ll come into your temple with burnt offerings and keep the vows I made to you,
the promises I spoke with my own lips when I was in trouble.
I’ll bring you fat animals as burnt offerings, including rams. I’ll offer bulls and goats. Selah.
Come and listen, all you who fear God. I’ll tell you what he’s done for me.
I cried out to him with my mouth, and my tongue lifted him up in praise.
If I’d held on to sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
But God did listen. He heard my prayer.
Blessed be God! He received my prayer and kept showing me his faithful love.
